title: Bot entry
description: An entry a DCA bot writes to the ledger (decision 0016, slice L2), as the payload of a journal row (journal-row.schema.json). The order engine's fold skips these; the runtime folds them, with the order engine's steps each bot heard, back into its bots. Times are milliseconds since the epoch on the runtime's wall clock; prices and sizes are decimal strings. Mirrors src/runtime/store/store.ts, BotEntry; the reducer's inputs are src/domain/dca/live.ts, BotInput.

request.description: Who asked for a command and under which id (decision 0010 d3, d4): the journaled command is its durable request row. principal is person, hook:<id>, key:<id>, link:<id> or runtime; hash is the SHA-256 of the body's canonical JSON; actor as the API derived it (a trading key's, B80: {kind: key, keyId, counted}, counted the quote its command counts against the key's 24 hours).

oneOf.title: Bot input
oneOf.description: One input of the bot's reducer that is not an order-engine step: create (with its settings, dca-bot-create.schema.json, the tick it starts from, and on spot `coinFee`, added for ruling 151), command, timer, allowance (the requests left on the account's allowance; `walletUntil`, added for B61, when the account's API wallet expires, absent when not known), position (the account's, the switch on), liquidation (`size` the bot's share, zero for a bot the split does not charge; `whole` the fill's size and `order` the liquidation order's id, both added in L2), venue-flat (the exchange flat on two healthy reads), funding (B64: the bot's share of one funding payment, `usdc` paid negative, `id` the venue receipt identity or the coin and venue time, booked once; optional receiptId links the native receipt to its display row. Compatibility: older inputs omit receiptId and retain their old identities), released (added 2026-10-03, 0003b d12: its account was removed from gcx; the bot is done as it stands, nothing cancelled or closed, RULINGS 23: stopped, or with `cause` account, added 2026-10-10 for 0003b amendment 3, error with the reason Account removed; an older build ignores it, or reads it without its cause; since 2026-11-16 (dca-released-cycle-1116) with `guard` true, written on every release and once at a start for a bot an older build released with its cycle open: when that cycle reaches zero it ends, counted, and no next cycle starts, and a Force close ends it before its close; a row without it folds as before; since 2026-11-16 (released-leftovers-1116) also with `quiet` true, written on every release and once at a start for a done bot an older build released without it: a fill of an order the bot left at the exchange is booked whole and the bot sends no order by itself, no close of a leftover, no take-profit for a late entry, no averaging; a row without it folds as before), pause (added 2026-10-04, ruling 73 (a): the trading key that created the bot was suspended or revoked, `on` true, or resumed, `on` false; an older build ignores it), recheck (added 2026-10-04, ruling 170 (b): the runtime's ledger shows room in the trading key's limits for a bot they alone hold; the bot enters as any due cycle does, counted again; an older build ignores it, the bot then waits for Retry as it did), wallet (added 2026-10-04, ruling 164 (b): a fresh read of the account's API wallet giving it more than a day, after a renewal, `walletUntil` its expiry as on allowance; a bot waiting in repair wallet-expiring resumes (since 2026-11-16, a row with `guard` true: only a bot still entering; a stopped or closing bot only loses the reason); an older build ignores it), differs (added 2026-10-05, decision 0016 Amendment 2: the runtime found, on two trusted reads 90 s apart, that the exchange's signed position on the coin, `exchange`, differs from the sum of the bots' records there since `since`, the last agreement, `cause` the likely one (liquidation, gcx, outside, none); with `agrees` true a trusted read agrees again and the item closes; written only for bots with "Only gcx trades this coin" on; an older build ignores it), reattach (added 2026-10-05, RULINGS 202 (b): a healthy read shows the exchange holding on the bot's side again while legs of its cycle's take-profit and stop-loss are gone with an earlier position; the bot makes them again, switch on or off, with no item open; an older build ignores it, the bot then runs without those exits as it did), correction (added 2026-10-06, decision 0028 d23: after an adopt whose rebuilt count does not reach the bot's share, what the fills did not reach: `was` and `now` the cycle's {size, cost} before and after, folded by now − was, `price` the figure used (the exchange's entry, or the bot's average), `pnl` "0", `between` {from, to} the bracket of the difference, `cause` unexplained or below-minimum, `reach` the oldest time the venue's history served when it did not reach the cycle's start; an older build ignores it and keeps its own cost), foreign (added 2026-10-06, decision 0028 d26: the yellow notice's facts with "Only this bot trades this pair" on, `fills` [{id, at, side, size, price}] on the pair not this bot's, `orders` [{id, side, size, price, kind?, exit?, trigger?, reduceOnly?}] resting at the exchange not this bot's (since 2026-11-14, venue-playbook §8d: a trigger also carries `kind` stop-market, stop-limit or trailing, `exit` tp or sl where the exchange names it, `trigger` its trigger price and `reduceOnly`; `price` stays the venue's limit price, "0" where it has none; a row without them reads as before), `exchange` the figure of a trusted read when one was made; one episode from its first row to the row with `clear` true; it holds nothing; an older build ignores it), claim-released (added 2026-10-09, ruling 406 b: a fresh trusted read showed the account flat on the coin of a bot stopped without closing that still claims a part of it; the bot lets go of it for good, holding nothing, its P&L, cycle and end as they were, nothing sent; a bot not done ignores it; an older build ignores it, the bot keeping its claim), run (added 2026-10-20, decision 0006 amendment 1 d3: nothing held the bot's coin's trades any more, so the price it heard says nothing about later; `at` is strictly after the last price it heard, and the bot prices nothing until a price of this run, as after a start; an older build folds it the same, through the bot's reducer), dust-conversion (added 2026-11-13, decision 0040 amendment 10: the exchange sold `size` of the bot's kept coins, its fee reserve and its last cycle's leftover under one step, at `price`, fee 0, `fillId` the row's id; every kept coin is gone after it, the sale less their cost is the last cycle's realized PnL; booked once; a done bot ignores it; an older build ignores it) or step: a tick the bot heard before a step because its own was older than the runtime's. Since 2026-11-16 (dca-done-repair-1116): the command kinds force-close and repair carry `guard` true, and so does the wallet row; with it Force close clears the entry's due and its five holds, a repair on a stopped bot with no order stuck is refused, and a re-place or a renewal makes the entry due only while the bot is entering; a row without it folds as before. Since 0028: differs carries `first` (the first read that differed, d24); the command kind keep ("Bot is right" on a red item, "Accept" on the yellow notice: the switch off, nothing sent); differs adopt carries `rebuild` {fills, was, now} (d22.7: the fills no bot's order made that the rebuild counted, and the cycle's figures at the press and rebuilt; the fold moves each by now − was; `share`, `was` and `price` stay for an older build); modify carries `wholePosition`, applied at once. Since 2026-11-14 (0063 ruling (a)): a modify whose `now` names `postOnly` applies it at once and asks the order reducer to change it on the cycle's averaging orders not sent yet (waiting for their trigger); a row whose `now` does not name it, or with no `now`, folds as before (it waits for the next cycle). Since 0017 A1: signal is an additive authoritative nonempty condition list with both legacy TA arrays explicitly empty; one atomic Modify carries all three fields, signal:null restores single TA; accepted arms remain facts. Since 0016 Amendment 7 (MH 669): modify carries `taPeriods` and `taSignals`, and its `from` is written exactly when a field waited for the next cycle (a cycle open at the press); an older build folds both the same. Since 0016 Amendment 9: the command kind modify-clear sets maxCycles, endAt, atEnd, slPct or slEnabled and removes maxCycles, endAt (with atEnd) or slLossPct (`clear`), the only command that sets or moves the end; an older build ignores it. Since 0016 amendment 14 (3.2.1): create and modify carry slMaxLossPct (the stop as a share of the Investment, worked out with no leverage); a modify setting one of slLossPct and slMaxLossPct removes the other from the next cycle; modify-clear's `clear` takes either name and removes whichever the bot holds; an older build ignores slMaxLossPct, its cycles running on slPct. Since MH 2026-11-13 ("we never withhold an order for a limit we believe the exchange has"): create and allowance carry `sendAll` true: from it the bot sends every entry and averaging order whose size is not zero, under the exchange's minimum value or not, and the exchange's refusal is handled as its refusal (entry-refused, level-failed); a row without it (an older build) keeps the hold it ran with (entry-too-small, a level not sent), so an older journal folds as it ran; an older build ignores the field. send-all (added 2026-11-14, lane held-back-orders-1114): written by a start of a later build for a bot not done whose rows carry no `sendAll`, or whose `minNotional` differs from the catalogue's today: the bot takes `sendAll` and, when given, `minNotional` (today's minimum order value), and its live cycle's averaging orders held under the minimum are sent as any is; `tick` the latest price of that run; an older journal has no such row and folds as it ran; an older build ignores it.

cycle.description: funding-allocation only: the recorded payment-time cycle, including a finished one. Compatibility: original funding inputs continue to select their current holding.

receiptId.description: Optional immutable venue payment identity on a funding input. Compatibility: absent on older inputs; their original id and display identity remain valid.

entryConditions.description: E5: optional facts captured when a TA arm is accepted, before allowance. Side is pre-Inverse. Absent on old arms means no condition detail; never inferred from current settings. Previous builds ignore this additive field.

account.description: A2 d61: held account value on allowance or d100(b) leverage input; null before a value has ever been held; no send-time or replay read

planTop.description: On allowance and leverage inputs, added 2026-11-14 (design 0064 d9): the cycle's unrounded plan, the typed Investment × its scale, in the settlement currency (a coin-margined contract's in its coin, as Invested is); Max planned reads it. A reading only: nothing sizes by it. Absent (older rows): Max planned is the entry's and levels' cost, as before.

needPerPlan.description: On allowance and leverage inputs of a perpetual bot, added 2026-11-14 (design 0064 d8): what the account needs for the cycle to reach its stop, in the settlement currency per unit of planTop; the cycle's own funds are what it holds × this. A reading only. Absent (older rows): ÷ the cycle's leverage, as before.

scale.description: A2 d69 / d100(b): the resolved cycle factor on allowance or leverage; old leverage rows without it remain display-only, old allowances without it retain the typed ladder

counted.description: On allowance only, added 2026-10-04 (ruling 109 2 (a)): a trading key's bot, what the cycle entering now counts against the key's 24 hours (its ladder at the bot's last price, in USDC). Absent for a bot no key created.

keyOver.description: On allowance only, added 2026-10-04 (ruling 109 2 (a)): the trading key's limits leave no room for this cycle; nothing is sent and the bot waits in repair key-limit. An older build reading it would enter the cycle; it never has such a bot.

against.description: On allowance only, added 2026-10-04 (ruling 172 (b)): a trading key's bot, the size the account holds on the other side of the cycle entering now, read with the allowance; its orders reduce it (one position per coin and account) and the bot reports it once. Absent when none. An older build ignores it.

marginMode.description: MH 2026-10-25, M1: mode read with allowance/leverage, selecting the recorded account-sizing factor; absent preserves previous arithmetic

leverage.description: On allowance and leverage inputs (d100(b)), added 2026-10-17 (MH 623 (c)-(e)): a perpetual bot whose stop is the expected loss (settings slLossPct), the account's leverage on the coin, read with the allowance; the cycle entering now works its stop out at it and keeps it. Absent when not read, and for every other bot: the cycle's stop is then the bot's slPct. An older build ignores it.

on.description: On pause only: true pauses, false resumes.

cause.description: Differs and correction carry their own cause (described above). On released, added 2026-10-10 (0003b amendment 3 d2, ruling 413.4): the bot's account was removed from gcx; the bot ends done error, its row's `released` account. Absent, as every older row: done stopped. An older build ignores it (done stopped).

kind.description: On liquidation only, added 2026-10-05 (decision 0016 Amendment 3 d5): the fill was the exchange's auto-deleveraging; the bot ends done (adl). Absent: a liquidation, as every older row. Its `size` is the bot's share of the fill (held over the exchange's position), as it always was the amount charged.

fee.description: On liquidation only, added 2026-10-05 (decision 0016 Amendment 3 d2): the bot's share of the fill's fee in quote (fee × share ÷ the sum of the sizes every party was charged, the bots' and the person's; on one side fee × share ÷ fill; MH ruling 226 a), booked into its realized PnL and fees. Absent: none, as every older row. An older build ignores it.

coinFee.description: On create only, added 2026-10-03 (ruling 151): on a spot pair whose buys pay their fee in the coin bought, the account's spot taker rate as a fraction, read when the bot was created (the venue's highest standard rate, Hyperliquid 0.0007, when the read failed); the bot's fee top-up is on from its first entry, and the first fill's own rate takes over. Absent (perpetuals, and every create written before): the top-up is off until a fill shows a fee in the coin.

fees.description: On create only, added 2026-11-11 (MH 2026-11-11: the DCA's Max loss counts the fees): the fee a fill pays as a fraction of its value, the exchange's plus ours where it is taken on the fill, for a resting limit (`maker`) and a market order (`taker`): the account's rates read when the bot was created, else the exchange's published ones. A stop set as the max loss (`slLossPct`) is worked out with them each cycle. Absent (every create written before, and an exchange whose rates are not known): the stop is worked out without fees, as before.

by.description: Added 2026-11-15 (NOTIFY-MODIFIED-1115): on a command row another bot's launch journaled with no request of its own (the pair's other bots turned to "Only this bot trades this pair" off, 0028 d21.7), who launched; only the notifier reads it (a launch by hand tells nothing of these rows). Absent on every other row and on older journals, which fold the same; an older build ignores it.

oneOf.title: Notification switches
oneOf.description: The bot's notification switches (decision 0009 d2): stops, TP and SL fills, entry and averaging fills from a level.

oneOf.title: A difference the person knows about
oneOf.description: 'I know why' on the line 'Bot · Exchange' (catalogue Q8): the exchange's size then; the line stays quiet until the difference grows past it.
